name: @zyxui AI Training Dataset
description: Training examples for AI models to learn @zyxui component usage patterns

examples.prompt: Create a user dashboard with statistics cards showing user count, revenue, and conversion rate with trend indicators
Build a user profile card with avatar, name, role, status badge, and message/follow buttons
Design a hero section for a landing page with a compelling headline, description, and call-to-action buttons
Create a contact form with name, email, subject, and message fields with validation
Build a settings page with tabs for profile, notifications, and security sections

examples.prompt: Create an article card with title, excerpt, author, publish date, and read more button
Design a notification component with icon, message, and action buttons
Create a team member grid with avatars, names, roles, and social links
Build a pricing table with different plans, features, and call-to-action buttons

patterns.dashboard: Data visualization with metric cards and navigation tabs
patterns.userProfile: User information display with avatar and action buttons
patterns.hero: Landing page header with headline and call-to-action
patterns.form: Data input with validation and submission
patterns.contentCard: Content preview with metadata and actions
patterns.notification: Alert or update display with actions
patterns.team: Team member showcase with contact options
patterns.pricing: Service plans comparison with features and pricing
